alerts.rationale: 0o600 is a Unix file permission mode passed to Permissions::from_mode and set_permissions. It is not a nonce, cryptographic key or salt. The 16-step displayed flow carries the io::Result through write_unlocked and the issue tuple to a test Grant before reading grant.nonce for a filename. In actual code, issue passes its explicit nonce parameter into mint_with_epoch and write_unlocked returns only a PathBuf; it does not mutate the borrowed Grant. The shown test obtains its nonce from crate::token::generate at grant.rs:854, which fills 32 random bytes at token.rs:14-17. A hard-coded crypto source is therefore not present in this path.
